script.base: Close home lean, not a blowout. Market has Carolina 23.8 and Tampa Bay 20.8. Carolina can feed Chuba Hubbard (67 carries, 324 yards in weeks 3/4/6) and still needs Bryce Young throws to score in the mid-20s, with Tetairoa McMillan the primary (30 targets, 295 yards, 299 air in that window). Tampa is only a 3-point dog, so Bucky Irving stays involved, but Emeka Egbuka is out and Baker Mayfield is questionable (thumb), so Tampa's pass game is short and fragile rather than a track meet. Total 44.5 is neutral volume.
script.flip1: Carolina leads by two scores early and clocks it with Hubbard. McMillan and Darren Waller targets stall late; Tampa throws more while trailing, but Mayfield's thumb plus Luke Goedeke out caps how many of those yards actually clear.
script.flip2: Shootout, or Tampa pressure (Goedeke out, Carolina blitz 37%, Tampa EPA/dropback -0.22 vs blitz) turns it into a messy pass game: Carolina deep shots rise with Antoine Winfield Jr. out, and Tampa checkdowns rise. The other miss is a slog — Tampa's rush defense is 3.72 YPC, which can stuff Hubbard and force Young to throw into a moderate total.

Final inactives not in the pack.

Tampa's unnamed safety replacement sat deep, the explosives never came, and Freeling was inactive so the blitz turned air yards into checkdowns. Waller was the 0 again: McMillan and Coker took the few downfield looks, and a 9-yard aDOT does not survive a 43% blitz when the game script is a grind. We also laid -113 and -112.5 into 50% fairs with no sim, so a true 55% read still had no price edge.
